validations.title: Host baseline
validations.description: Checks that each Server keeps time with the installation's NTP server, shows the CPUs and memory its hardware inspection found, and has a writable root filesystem with free space. It only reads the Servers.

maxClockOffsetMs.title: Largest clock offset (ms)
maxClockOffsetMs.description: How far a clock may be from the installation's NTP server. Default 1000.

minCpus.title: Fewest CPUs
minCpus.description: The CPUs each Server must show. Default: the count its hardware inspection found.

minMemoryGib.title: Least memory (GiB)
minMemoryGib.description: The memory each Server must show. Default: 90% of what its hardware inspection found.

checks.title: Time synchronization
checks.description: The clock is synchronized and within the largest offset of the installation's NTP server.

checks.title: CPU count
checks.description: The OS shows at least the expected number of CPUs.

checks.title: Memory
checks.description: The OS shows at least the expected memory.

checks.title: Root filesystem
checks.description: The root filesystem is writable and has at least the least free space.
